property_summary: For any owner caller and any target logger address L and boolean S, after calling setApprovedLogger(L,S) the contract's approvedLoggers(L) equals S; the mutant that writes approvedLoggers[msg.sender] instead will leave approvedLoggers(L) unchanged when msg.sender != L, so there exist inputs (owner caller != L) where approvedLoggers(L) differs between reference and mutant.
change_summary: Change the assignment to set the approved logger mapping at msg.sender instead of the provided _logger address.
